title: Pool protocol v1 message: body_abort (router -> coordinator)
description: Sent after offer_accept when the router aborts the body stream (GET /pool/jobs/{job_id}/body) before or during transfer, e.g. the model was unloaded mid-transfer. Aborting the stream = closing the HTTP stream; this envelope tells the coordinator the job did not take the body.

job_id.description: Job id of the aborted body pull.

reason.description: model_gone: model unloaded mid-transfer; no_slot: slot became unavailable; evicted: model evicted; other: anything else.
